title: Finding retraction act payload
description: Ends the current support supplied by one identified finding. A retraction supplies no replacement value and asserts no opposite proposition: the stable fact keeps its identity and simply has no current answer until it is answered again by a later assertion, which is a new event with a new finding id (never a revival of this one). The payload names the finding, never the fact: the fact is derived from the named finding, so a client that reads the latest revision but names a superseded finding is refused rather than silently retracting a later correction. It names no value, no reason, no replacement, and no actor - who retracts is recorded in the act envelope and never consulted at admission, exactly as correction authority is a state gate and not a permission check (ADR-0041).
